basic_details.job_title: TIFR Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Project Associate and Senior Project Associate Posts
basic_details.short_information: Tata Institute of Fundamental Research (TIFR) is recruiting candidates for Project Associate and Senior Project Associate posts on a project-based engagement in Mumbai. The tenure is initially for one year and can be extended to a maximum of another two years based on performance. Qualifications vary by post, and the monthly pay is Rs. 40,000 for GATE qualified Project Associate candidates, Rs. 30,000 for the rest, and Rs. 60,000 for Senior Project Associate. Eligible applicants can apply by email by sending the detailed CV in the specified format, along with additional qualifications, publica

how_to_apply: Prepare a detailed CV including date of birth, present affiliation and occupation, address, contact number, and email ID.

Include educational qualifications in the specified tabular format provided in the notification, covering S.S.C, H.S.C, B.E./B.Tech., M.E./M.Tech., and Ph.D. degrees with year, university, subjects, marks obtained/rank/score, and remarks.
Include additional qualifications such as qualifying in CSIR/UGC or GATE, publications, awards, and a one-page write-up of research or work experience.
Provide the name and address of two referees who are familiar with your recent academic activities and progress.
Gather scanned copies of your SSC, HSC, B.Tech., M.Tech., and Ph.D. degree certificates as applicable.
Send the completed application and attachments via email to Prof. Gagan B Mohanty at [email protected].
Set the subject line of the email strictly as: "Application for the Project Associate / Senior Project Associate (keep one) position."

content_sections.heading: TIFR Project Associate at a Glance

rows.details: Initially for 1 year, extendable up to a maximum of another 2 years based on performance
Rs. 40,000/- (for GATE qualified Project Associate), Rs. 30,000/- (for other Project Associates), Rs. 60,000/- (for Senior Project Associate)
Below 28 years (Project Associate) / Below 32 years (Senior Project Associate) as on closing date

rows.essential_qualification: B.E./B.Tech. in Electronics / Electronics & Communication / Electrical & Electronics / Electronics & Telecommunications OR M.Sc. in Electronics / Electronic Sciences with minimum 60% aggregate marks from a recognized University / Institute.
rows.desirable_qualification: Minimum of one-year experience in research labs. Freshers will be considered if experienced candidates are not available.

rows.essential_qualification: M.E./M.Tech. in Electronics / Electronics & Communication / Electrical & Electronics / Electronics & Telecommunications (min. 60% aggregate marks) OR Ph.D. in Expt. High Energy / Nuclear Physics with hardware experience. Candidates who have submitted their Ph.D. thesis and are awaiting the Viva may also apply.
rows.desirable_qualification: Minimum of two years' experience in research labs for the M.E./M.Tech. candidates.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The positions are concurrent with an extramural project in the Department of High Energy Physics at the Tata Institute of Fundamental Research, Mumbai. The engagement begins with a one-year term and is renewable for up to two additional years depending on performance. Monthly consolidated pay is fixed at Rs. 40,000/- for GATE-qualified Project Associates, Rs. 30,000/- for other Project Associates, and Rs. 60,000/- for Senior Project Associates.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TIFR Project Associate
content_sections.text: Prepare a detailed CV including date of birth, present affiliation and occupation, address, contact number, and email ID. Include educational qualifications in the specified tabular format provided in the notification, covering S.S.C, H.S.C, B.E./B.Tech., M.E./M.Tech., and Ph.D. degrees with year, university, subjects, marks obtained/rank/score, and remarks. Include additional qualifications such as qualifying in CSIR/UGC or GATE, publications, awards, and a one-page write-up of research or work experience. Provide the name and address of two referees who are familiar with your recent academic activities and progress. Gather scanned copies of your SSC, HSC, B.Tech., M.Tech., and Ph.D. degree certificates as applicable. Send the completed application and attachments via email to Prof. Gagan B Mohanty at [email protected] . Set the subject line of the email strictly as: "Application for the Project Associate / Senior Project Associate (keep one) position."

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The method of selection for both Project Associate and Senior Project Associate positions is through a Personal Interview.
